related.title: AMD CDNA 晶粒：工作切分與慢端效應
related.titleEn: AMD CDNA chiplets: partitioning and stragglers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：所有容量使用同一單位，峰值與穩態皆列出，超額請求可預測地排隊或回退。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use one capacity unit, record peak and steady allocations, and queue or fall back predictably on excess requests.
related.difference: 區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可用KV容量=總容量−權重−暫存−保留量；每請求容量固定時以向下取整決定上限。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 假想加速器80 GiB，權重28 GiB、暫存8 GiB、保留4 GiB，每請求KV2.5 GiB。 KV餘量=80−28−8−4=40 GiB；40/2.5=16個請求。未包含長度變動時的額外增長。
相同速率的平行分區在屏障前以最大工作量決定時間；負載效率=總工作/(分區數×最大工作)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 四個教學分區的工作為100、100、100、180單位；相同速率且忽略互連成本。 效率=480/(4×180)=66.6667%；重新平衡為四個120則理想效率100%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Available KV capacity equals total minus weights, workspace and reserve; divide by per-request usage and round down. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Hypothetical80 GiB accelerator, 28 GiB weights, 8 GiB workspace, 4 GiB reserve and 2.5 GiB KV/request. KV headroom=80−28−8−4=40 GiB; 40/2.5=16 requests, before additional growth from variable lengths.

Equal-rate partitions finish at the largest workload; load efficiency=total/(partition count×maximum). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Four teaching partitions carry100, 100, 100, 180 units at equal rates, initially ignoring interconnect cost. Efficiency=480/(4×180)=66.6667%; four balanced120-unit partitions reach ideal100%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google Coral Edge TPU：CPU 回退的臨界路徑
related.titleEn: Google Coral Edge TPU: CPU fallback critical paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：所有容量使用同一單位，峰值與穩態皆列出，超額請求可預測地排隊或回退。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use one capacity unit, record peak and steady allocations, and queue or fall back predictably on excess requests.
related.difference: 依時間與傳輸分析回退代價，不能以加速算子數比例估速度。
related.differenceEn: Analyze fallback by time and transfers, not the fraction of operator count accelerated.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可用KV容量=總容量−權重−暫存−保留量；每請求容量固定時以向下取整決定上限。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 假想加速器80 GiB，權重28 GiB、暫存8 GiB、保留4 GiB，每請求KV2.5 GiB。 KV餘量=80−28−8−4=40 GiB；40/2.5=16個請求。未包含長度變動時的額外增長。
串行推論延遲等於各分區執行時間與邊界傳輸之和；算子數沒有時間權重。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 TPU分區2 ms，CPU尾段12 ms，邊界複製1 ms；CPU尾段僅占兩個算子。 總延遲2+12+1=15 ms；CPU尾段占80%，不能因算子少而忽略。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Available KV capacity equals total minus weights, workspace and reserve; divide by per-request usage and round down. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Hypothetical80 GiB accelerator, 28 GiB weights, 8 GiB workspace, 4 GiB reserve and 2.5 GiB KV/request. KV headroom=80−28−8−4=40 GiB; 40/2.5=16 requests, before additional growth from variable lengths.

Serial latency sums partition execution and boundary transfers; operator counts have no timing weights. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. TPU partition2 ms, CPU tail12 ms, boundary copy1 ms; the CPU tail contains only two operators. Total 2+12+1=15 ms; the CPU tail contributes80% despite few operators.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
